Task complete. Summary:

- **`out/T1/solution.py`**: a plain script on top of `safetensors.torch` (load_file/save_file) that drops blocks 2/5/8, renumbers survivors via a single old→new index map (avoiding shift-order collisions), passes through the 4 non-block tensors unchanged, and enforces the three required checks (no blocks 9/10/11 remain, exactly 9 blocks via `attn.c_attn.weight` count, exactly 121 tensors) — exiting non-zero and writing nothing if any check fails.
- **`out/T1/run.sh`**: invokes it with the sandbox's `.venv/bin/python`.
- Ran once, succeeded first try, wrote `out/T1/model.safetensors` (121 tensors, 430MB).
- Independently verified: non-block tensors bit-exact, all 9 surviving blocks bit-exact against their mapped originals (dtype/shape/values), and only new indices 0–8 present.
- **`out/T1/REPORT.md`**: participant self-report filled in per `record-template.md`, noting the collision-avoidance approach and why a direct script was chosen over mergekit/torch-state-bridge.
